issues.title: Option text clipping
issues.description: Option label overflows and clips into the dropdown chevron without proper truncation styling.
issues.evidence: The label shows 'us-east-1 · Virgini' with the end of the text cut off by the chevron.
issues.suggestion: Add text truncation with ellipsis and ensure sufficient right padding for the icon.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: the select relies on default text-overflow (clip), so long values hard-clip next to the chevron overlay; added truncate (overflow-hidden + text-ellipsis) to the base select classes in native-select.tsx.
